decision: Downloaded the video with yt-tools at 720p after the user said it was not on disk
why: The brief's VIDEO_PATH was an unfilled placeholder and the user then pointed me at their downloader. 720p is enough to read screen text, and the next size up roughly doubles the download time at the 150 KB/s cap
result: video in the yt-tools cache, path recorded in source.json

decision: Followed the pstack skills (poteto-mode, swarm, show-me-your-work, technical-writing, unslop) by reading their SKILL.md files
why: The Skill tool did not list them in this session. The pstack Claude Code adapter says to read the file and follow it

decision: Frames stay PNG and are tracked with Git LFS
why: git-lfs 3.7.1 is installed, so the JPG fallback does not apply

decision: Built the pipeline venv on Python 3.12, not the system 3.14, and use the ffmpeg bundled with imageio-ffmpeg
why: ctranslate2 wheels for faster-whisper do not cover 3.14, and ffmpeg/ffprobe are not on PATH. imageio-ffmpeg ships no ffprobe, so common.probe() reads resolution from the ffmpeg banner

decision: Each [inferred] tag in a breakdown carries an id like M3-I04
why: Finish check 4 needs an exact way to match each inferred item to the design doc's Open Questions. Matching on free text would be fuzzy and easy to game

decision: The design doc's styling lives in a rendered HTML copy, not in the markdown
why: Markdown and GitHub drop CSS, so Arial 10pt and greyscale headings cannot live in the .md. render_doc.py writes design_document.html with that CSS
result: doc ships as .md plus a styled .html

decision: Agent stages (2, 3, 4) are rerun from versioned briefs in design/pipeline/prompts/
why: These stages need judgment and cannot be plain scripts. A saved brief makes each one rerunnable on its own
